# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the code on the default branch is actively maintained. Security fixes are
made against the latest commit there; no older tags or releases receive
back-ported patches.

| Version              | Supported          |
| --------------------- | ------------------ |
| Default branch (latest) | :white_check_mark: |
| Older commits/tags     | :x:                 |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, report it privately using [GitHub Security Advisories](../../security/advisories/new)
for this repository. Include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept
- Any suggested remediation, if known

We aim to acknowledge new reports within a few business days. Once a fix is
available, we will coordinate disclosure and credit the reporter (unless
anonymity is requested).
